articles.title: Ledger CTO urges AI bug hunter responsibility, warns against ‘attention farming’
articles.snippet: Ledger and Trezor said researchers have a responsibility to publish their findings if vendors fail to fix bugs within an agreed disclosure window.

articles.title: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift
articles.snippet: Citi and DBS completed their first tokenized cross-border transfer over the weekend, using Swift’s blockchain-based ledger to circumvent the constraints of traditional banking hours.
